title: Senior Sales Representative
description:
**Who we need? - Sales Representative**

- An ideal candidate would be a proactive, target-oriented and experienced Sales Representative with a strong background in the metal manufacturing, precision engineering, industrial components or instrumentation industry.

- The candidate will be responsible for identifying prospective customers, generating new business enquiries, maintaining relationships with existing customers, following up on quotations and converting business opportunities into confirmed orders.

- The candidate must have a practical understanding of the products, manufacturing processes and capabilities of a metal manufacturing company. We are specifically looking for someone who understands the industrial products we manufacture and can confidently communicate with customers, understand their requirements and identify relevant business opportunities.

**What will a Sales Representative do?**

- Identify and approach potential domestic and international B2B customers in relevant industrial sectors.

- Generate new business enquiries through LinkedIn, email campaigns, online platforms, industry databases, referrals and other sales channels.

- Research potential customers, manufacturers, OEMs, distributors, importers and industrial buyers.

- Develop and maintain a database of prospective customers and decision-makers.

- Conduct regular customer outreach through emails, telephone calls, LinkedIn and virtual meetings.

- Identify opportunities for new product development and business expansion within existing and new customer accounts.

- Maintain regular communication and professional relationships with existing and prospective customers.

- Understand customer requirements, product specifications, drawings, quantities and delivery expectations.

- Handle routine customer enquiries and coordinate with the technical sales team wherever detailed engineering assistance is required.

- Follow up regularly on pending enquiries, quotations, samples and purchase orders.

- Ensure timely responses to customer communications and maintain professional correspondence.

- Understand customer purchasing patterns, annual requirements and potential repeat business opportunities.

- Maintain customer satisfaction and develop long-term business relationships.

- Receive and review incoming customer enquiries and RFQs.

- Understand customer requirements and ensure all relevant technical and commercial information is collected.

- Coordinate with the Sales Engineer and Engineering Department for technical evaluation and quotation preparation.

- Send quotations and follow up consistently until the enquiry reaches a definite outcome.

- Maintain records of quotation status, customer feedback, negotiations and order conversion.

- Coordinate with internal departments for order status updates and customer communication.

- Identify reasons for lost enquiries and report competitor pricing, market feedback and customer concerns to management.

- Maintain accurate customer records and sales activities in the company's CRM/ERP system.

- Maintain daily, weekly and monthly sales activity reports.

- Prepare lead-generation, enquiry, quotation and order-conversion reports.

- Maintain an updated customer follow-up schedule.

- Track individual sales targets, achievements and pending business opportunities.

- Submit regular MIS reports to the Sales Manager.

- Ensure all customer communications and business commitments are properly documented.

**An efficient Sales Representative should have:**

- A Critical Thinker

- A Positive Attitude

- Excellent communication, email drafting, follow-up and customer relationship management skills.

- Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, CRM and ERP systems.

- Ability to independently generate leads and manage customer follow-ups.

- Multi-tasking skills

- Problem Solving Skills

- Time Management Skills

- Excellent Troubleshooting Skills

- Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.

- Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.

- A supportive Team Member

- Ability to achieve sales targets on time and meet work deadlines.

**Minimum Education Requirements:**

- 5-7 years of experience in industrial B2B sales or sales representation.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Mechanical Engineering, Product Engineering or a related technical field is preferred.

- Previous experience as a Sales Representative in metal manufacturing, precision engineering, industrial instrumentation, CNC machining, industrial fittings or engineering components is mandatory.

- Strong understanding of industrial products, manufacturing processes, and the needs of manufacturing clients.

- Willingness to travel as required to meet with clients and attend industry events.

Location: Neemrana, Rajasthan

Job Type: Full-time

Workplace: In-office

**Salary: Can be discussed**

**﻿**
Working Hours: as per company need.
